title: Azhagai Irukkirai Bayamai Irukkirathu
desc: Manu loves Jo, but when he realises she loves Prem, he decides to help her win his heart. Soon, he and Jo plot to separate Prem from his lover, Nandini.

title: Shivam
desc: Shiva, the ever-helpful friend, finds himself smitten with Tanu, sparking a love story that stirs up trouble with Bhoji Reddy.

title: Meiyazhagan
desc: Arul visits his hometown for a wedding. He meets a relative whose kindness helps him reconnect with forgotten family ties and precious memories.

title: Saivam
desc: When ill luck befalls a family, Kathiresan decides to please the gods by offering their pet rooster as a sacrifice. However, things do not go as expected as the rooster goes missing.

title: Bheemla Nayak
desc: A battle begins between SI Bheemla Nayak, a righteous policeman, and Daniel Shekhar, an ex-havildar, when Daniel tricks Bheemla into surrendering to corruption.

title: Taanakkaran
desc: Arivu and his trainee friends face the wrath of a ruthless trainer, Eshwaramurthy, who later plots schemes to demotivate and punish the entire batch.

title: Surya vs. Surya
desc: Surya suffers from a hereditary medical condition which does not permit him to go outdoors. Things change when he falls in love with Sanjana, a TV anchor.

title: Vengamamba
desc: Vengamamba's life becomes chaotic when her husband dies. Meanwhile, an ardent devotee of Lord Venkateswara tries to help her through difficult times.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: OK Kanmani
desc: Adi and Tara meet during a wedding ceremony and fall in love. However, they decide to start a live-in relationship as they do not believe in the institution of marriage.

title: Pa. Pandi
desc: Pandian Pazhanisami, a retired man, misses his youthful days and embarks on a mission to find his first love and reconnect with her.
